description: PROPOSAL ONLY (#71). What #82 appends to Plugin API Level 2 if this design is accepted: members for PluginInterfaceContracts.levelTwoMembers, catalogue entries and builders. Not a Candidate Contract: Level 2 is still open, so these join Level 2 itself. check.py holds each member to the published catalogue.

members.name: page_sources
members.note: A page may carry sources, sampled only while it is visible, kept while their definition is unchanged under the same handler Command

members.name: source_bindings
members.note: A text component may bind to a source; the Host shows its latest result, formatted, without running the script

members.name: source_delivered
members.note: A result of a source with deliver, change-gated, floored and coalesced to the latest; not a gesture

members.name: http.request
members.note: A new member kind, as request was added for Requested Host Operations: an operation a page may name in a source's perform. Once only, if Q5 is decided as recommended

catalogue.entry_points.source: The Host performs it for a visible view and shows or delivers the result: a Host-Fetched Section of a Level 1 view, or a Host-run source of a page (reference/sources.md).

http.request.entry_points.source.note: A Host-Fetched Section's fetch.request at Level 1; a page source's input at Level 2, whose result adds json, the parsed body

builders.summary: Builds a text component's bind member: bind(source, pointer, {format, unavailable})
Builds a page source from a catalogue ID and input: ui.source(id, perform, input, {every, deliver}); spinnet.http.request.source(input, options) is the same for http.request

later.note: Its entry_points.source turns from reserved to level2, with its input, result, minimum interval and authority (Q3)
Illustrative name only: #85 names the Spotify read, adds failures external_app_not_running and automation_permission_needed, and decides Q4
